attributes.heading: ex Chapter 64
attributes.subdivision: Footwear, gaiters and the like; parts of such articles

attributes.rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading, except from assemblies of uppers affixed to inner soles or to other sole components of [heading 6406](/headings/6406).
Manufacture in which the value of all the materials used does not exceed **50%** of the ex-works price of the product.
